home.come.1.testo: Any page with a video in it: a platform you know, or some site you've never heard of.
home.come.2.testo: If the site offers an official player we use that. Otherwise we extract the stream and serve it clean.
home.come.3.testo: No popups, no banners, no ads stitched into the stream. Just the video, full screen if you want.
home.faq.1.d: Do I need to sign up?
home.faq.1.r: No. The moment you arrive you already have your own account, with your own history. If one day you want a login, it attaches to the account you already have: you lose nothing by signing up.
home.faq.2.r: No, and there are no ads. It's an open project: the code is there to read.
home.faq.3.d: Does it work on phones and tablets?
home.faq.3.r: Yes, from the browser, nothing to install. On iPhone and iPad the sound starts on your first tap, because the system insists on it.
home.faq.4.d: Does it really remove the ads?
home.faq.4.r: The ones stitched into the stream, yes: we strip them as the playlist passes through us, and those are precisely the ones no browser blocker can see. Inside a platform's own official player, though, the platform's ads stay.
home.faq.5.r: No. cleanvid hosts nothing and uploads nothing: it shows what the original site already serves, without the frame around it.
home.guida: Paste a page's address and only the video is left. What you open goes into your history, which is yours and nobody else's: you already have an account, without doing anything.
home.vuoto: Nothing yet. The first link you open shows up here.
home.vuoto.preferiti: Nothing yet. The star on a cover brings it here.
